SELECT icam50_source_id AS source_id, icam50_std_date AS std_date, icam50_server_type AS server_type, icam50_owner AS owner, icam50_type AS type, icam50_name AS name, icam50_line_cnt AS line_cnt, to_char(icam50_work_date,'yyyy-mm-dd HH24:MI:SS') AS work_date_string, icam50_text AS text FROM icam50_source WHERE 1=1
ORDER BY icam50_server_type, icam50_owner, icam50_type, icam50_name LIMIT #{p.limit} OFFSET #{p.offset}
SELECT count(*) FROM icam50_source WHERE icam50_std_date = f_today()
